title: Add RAG session graph visualizer and local tool stubs for playground
author: Asha Patel
description: Introduce a developer-facing RAG playground enhancement: a Graph Visualizer that renders an interactive flow of retrieval, tool calls, and generation steps using a lightweight Graphviz renderer, plus a set of inline local tool stubs and a guided quickstart doc. Motivation: make RAG flow debugging and education faster for engineers onboarding to Redwood’s examples, especially for tool-calling and multi-step traces. This PR adds the visualizer UI component, a small runtimes shim for instrumenting step metadata, three example tool stubs (search, db-read, and code-exec) with deterministic responses for local testing, a docs quickstart page (quickstarts/rag-visualizer.md) with step-by-step authoring and troubleshooting tips, unit + e2e tests for the visualizer behavior and telemetry hooks, and a CI smoke workflow that runs the playground in headless mode. Checklist: [x] visualizer UI + renderer; [x] tool stubs and example bundles; [x] docs quickstart; [x] tests; [x] CI smoke workflow; [x] telemetry events (instrumentation only, no PII). Related: adds a small telemetry event schema extension to aid tracing across tool boundaries (backwards compatible). Links: Linear ENG-1987 for visualizer design notes, internal playbook URL: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1987, demo GIF: https://internal-assets.example/redwood/rag-visualizer-demo.gif. Note: telemetry is opt-in in local quickstart; no production changes to runtime behavior are included in this PR.
commit_summary: feat(playground): add graph visualizer component and graphviz renderer integration
feat(examples): add three local tool stubs (search, db-read, code-exec) with deterministic fixtures
docs(quickstarts): add rag-visualizer quickstart with troubleshooting and telemetry opt-in
test(playground): unit and e2e tests for visualizer step rendering and edge cases
ci: introduce visualizer-smoke workflow for headless playground validation
chore: update changelog and example manifests
review_comments: Jonah Kim: Nice UX — please ensure the graph respects privacy flags and strips prompt text before rendering (addressed in graphviz-adapter).
Priya Desai: Tests look good, but the e2e flaked on CI once; added a retry and locked the fixture timestamps to avoid time-based flakiness (fixed).
Marco Li: Can we keep telemetry opt-in in the quickstart? Confirmed and documented the opt-in toggle.
Asha Patel (author): Responded with small follow-ups and a patch to remove prompt previews from the visualizer, pushed follow-up commit to tidy tests.
release_notes: Add RAG Playground Graph Visualizer and local tool stubs to examples. Developers can now visualize retrieval and tool-call flows in the playground and run deterministic local stubs for iterative debugging. No production runtime changes.
